unit.why: A short anecdote about R. Yitzhak (of the Besht's circle) in a lawsuit: he warns that whoever lies before him loses a child, which happens, and the liar confesses.

stories.summary_en: When a litigant before R. Yitzhak accepted an oath he was about to swear falsely, and his opponent pressed for it, R. Yitzhak explained that anyone who lies before him loses one of his offspring, so he waits for repentance; a child of the liar indeed died and he confessed the truth.
